rules.description: An attribute accepts 'allocation' but declares a formula base (allocation is legal only on a direct base).
An instant effect carries a non-one_shot modifier (continuous/periodic require a timed/infinite duration).
An attr node — in an attribute base formula or an effect magnitude — references an id not declared in attributes.items.
An attribute participates in a cycle of the base-formula dependency graph.
A probability attribute's direct base is outside the domain's [0, 1] space.
A declared bounds object declares neither floor nor cap (it narrows nothing).
A bounds object declares floor greater than cap.
A probability attribute's bounds declare a side outside the domain's [0, 1] space.
A percentage/probability attribute declares no bounds (bounds are mandatory for those domains).
An exponential form's resolved growth_rate is not strictly positive.
A base-formula expression tree is deeper than 32.
A base-formula expression tree has more than 256 nodes.
A polynomial form has 0 or more than 8 coefficients.
A piecewise_linear form has fewer than 2 points, or a lookup_table fewer than 1 entry.
A piecewise_linear/lookup_table form's x-values are not strictly increasing.
An instant effect declares stacking (it leaves no instance).
A modifier's target names no attribute declared in attributes.items.
An override modifier is applied as a one_shot/periodic delta (override replaces, it is not a delta).
A param node — in an attribute base formula or an effect magnitude — references an id not declared in parameters.
A period is below the v1 minimum tick granularity (0.05 s).
An effect whose modifiers are all one_shot declares a period.
An effect with a periodic modifier declares no period.
A timed/infinite effect declares no stacking.
A reserved top-level section is present (refused until its owning issue designs it).
The document's $schema disagrees with the versioned structural schema $id.
A persistent effect's stacking.type names no declared stacking type.
A timed duration or a period is not strictly positive.
A timed effect's duration / period exceeds the per-instance tick budget (10 000).
A labeled attribute violates its tier's facet pattern (accepts by exact set equality).
An attribute's tier label names no declared tier.
